description: Capability for the main window. The webview loads the dev-server UI from a loopback http://localhost:<port> origin, which Tauri treats as REMOTE content — so app commands (github_sign_in / github_is_signed_in / github_sign_out / github_open_verification) must opt that origin in via `remote.urls` (Phase 28 / DDR-108/109). The port is dynamic (4399→4401 on collision), hence the loopback wildcard. SECURITY: the untrusted cross-origin canvas iframe (a different localhost port) does NOT receive the Tauri IPC global — init scripts inject into the top frame only — so it cannot invoke despite the wildcard match; and none of these commands return the token (the token bridge is loopback HTTP + key, not a Tauri command). Verified in the DDR-109 security pass.
